desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed problem, identified monotonic stack approach with window constraint k.
Implement a helper function to calculate the sum of maximums for all subarrays of length at most k using a monotonic stack approach to find valid left and right boundaries for each element.
Implement a similar helper function to calculate the sum of minimums for all subarrays of length at most k, ensuring correct boundary conditions to handle duplicates properly.
In the main function, call both helper functions and return the sum of their results.
Test the solution with provided examples and additional edge cases to verify correctness.
